title.zh: Solana sandwich bots took $29.7 million before costs, mostly targeting Pump.fun
title.en: Solana sandwich bots took $29.7 million before costs, mostly targeting Pump.fun

current_state.zh: Blockchain data provider Bitquery estimates Solana sandwich bots extracted roughly $29.7 million in gross proceeds over 11 months, with 96% of detected attacks concentrated on Pump.fun's launch curve and PumpSwap and high-slippage Jupiter routes sandwiched 14 times as often as low-slippage ones.
